title: 7075-T6 Al Patterned Tubes
body_html:
Inventory Status: Shipment arrived. Items currently undergoing inspection.

Description

7075-T6 Patterned Tubes enable users to smoothly mount diverse subsystems and easily pair them with jigs for creating bearing holes. 7075-T6 Al is significantly stronger than 6061 Al, allowing for more durable and lighter constructions.

Features

  • High strength-to-weight (7075-T6)
  • Consistent pattern for subsystem mounting
  • Jig-friendly for accurate bearing holes 
  • Black, corrosion-resistant finish (anodized)

Specifications

  • Length: 47"
  • Thickness: 0.0625" (1/16)
  • Profile: 2”x1”
  • Hole Spacing: 0.5" (1/2)
  • Thru-holes: #10 bolts
  • Material: 7075-T6
  • Color: Black

Note: Slight fillets exist on the inside and outside corners to improve strength and manufacturability. Compatible with standard end caps/tube plugs sold by other vendors.

title: Grip Rollers
body_html:

Each Grip Roller comes assembled with a black 45A durometer silicone sleeve covering a black polycarbonate tube.

  • Inner Diameter (ID): 1.00"

  • Tube Material: Polycarbonate

title: Prototyping Bumper Foam
body_html:
Description

47" Prototyping Bumper Foam features a 3lb Open-Cell XPE outer layer for durability and shape control, along with a 5lb Closed-Cell EVA inner core for enhanced, repeated impact absorption. The rounded outer profile improves interaction with other robots and over-the-bumper intakes.

Please Read: The outer Open-Cell XPE portion is not allowed under the 2026 FRC Rules. This bumper "as is" cannot be legally used in an official FRC competition, but given its shape and properties, can be great for testing drivetrains or other mechanical components. 

Additionally, the interior closed-cell EVA is legal and can be used after removing the outer portion. This foam will only be available while supply lasts.

Features

  • Multi-layer impact absorption
  • Holds shape under sustained compression
  • Rounded outer edges
  • Durable, intake-friendly design
  • Reduced deformation and grabbing
  • Sized to match traditional FRC Bumpers

Specifications

  • Length: 47"
  • Width (Thickness): 2.5"
  • Height: 5"
  • Outer: 3lb Open-Cell XPE
  • Inner: 5lb Closed-Cell EVA
  • Weight: 1.3lb

title: Belt Clamping Blocks
body_html:
Description

Clamping blocks secure the end of a timing belt to a structure, creating a fixed point. This allows the belt to translate motion more precisely, which is perfect for linear systems. Those include elevators or intakes. Clamping blocks maintain tension, prevent slippage, and ensure accurate, repeatable positioning. 

Features

  • Made out of 6061-T6 Al
  • For 9mm or 18mm wide 5mm HTD belts
  • Multiple mounting positions

Note: Includes four #10-32 1/2" Socket Button Screws for clamping. However, the hardware for mounting is not included.

title: Idler Sprockets
body_html:
Description

Idler Sprockets guide chain, optimize wrap angles, and maintain smooth system performance. Unlike other sprockets, idlers do not transmit power. Instead, they ensure your chain system stays aligned, stable, and properly engaged. Built for reliability and low-friction operation, they help prevent slippage, reduce wear, and increase efficiency.

Features

  • Pre-pressed with two R188ZZ Bearings
    • (ID: 0.250" & OD: 0.500")
  • Can be used with #25 or #25H Chain
  • Type: 12T
  • Made out of 7075-T6 Al
  • Black Anodized

title: Open-Loop Belt Tensioner
body_html:
Description

The Open Loop Belt Tensioner provides a reliable solution for maintaining tension in open belt systems, ensuring smooth operation and reducing wear. Designed for compact and efficient setups, this tensioner is ideal for applications requiring precise adjustments and robust performance.

Features

  • Unassembled with hardware included
  • Great for tensioning belts for belt-driven elevators
  • Compatibility with 9mm to 18mm wide belts
  • Grooved design for secure belt alignment
  • Durable aluminum (6061-T6) construction for high-strength performance
  • Compact size for easy integration into tight spaces
  • In-line tension load to increase strength

title: Retention Bearing Hats
body_html:
Retention Bearing Hats are a sleek and functional solution for securely retaining bearings in assemblies. Its precise design ensures proper alignment and stability, minimizing the risk of bearing misalignment during operation. Perfect for high-performance robotics systems, this component adds reliability and durability to your build.

Features

  • For 1.125" OD Flanged bearings
  • Lightweight and durable aluminum construction
  • 75°, 180°, and 240° open design for customizable hardware installation and removal
  • Provides retention while minimizing friction on bearings
  • Hole can be tapped with a #10-32 threading
  • Quantity of 1 per order

Note: This product was made available in collaboration with Team 4488 Shockwave.

title: Continuous Belt Tensioner
body_html:
Description

The Continuous (closed-loop) Belt Tensioner ensures consistent belt tension, preventing slippage and reducing wear during high-torque operations. Its compact, lightweight design makes it ideal for mechanisms, improving reliability and efficiency.

Features

  • Adjustable mounting for versatile integration
  • 0.625" width to fit two 0.375" ID bearings (flanged or radial)
  • Can easily implement custom rollers
  • Durable aluminum construction (6061-T6)
  • Center-to-center slot distance is 0.5" which can be used for patterned tubes
  • Compact design for space-constrained builds

Note: Bearings and hardware not included. Suggested hardware is 10-32 screws and locknuts.

title: Reinforced HTD Pulley 5mm
body_html:
Description

Reinforced HTD ("RHTD") Pulleys allow users to opt for timing belts as opposed to chain, which are lighter, provide higher efficiency, and require lower maintenance. Additionally, Reinforced HTD Pulleys are designed to handle heavier loads and attain greater performance over other pulleys, such as GT2s. 

Unlike normal HTD Pulleys, RHTD Pulleys are designed to prevent flanges from dislocating under heavy impact. This also enables individuals to customize the flanges attached to the pulley and replace them as needed.

Features

  • Hardware attached, replaceable flanges
  • Impact Resistant
  • Clocked
  • Interfaces with other devices for better torque transference
  • Made out of 6061-T6 Al
  • For 9mm wide 5mm HTD belts
  • Small protrusion for properly contacting the face of bearings

Maintenance 

All RHTD Pulleys have medium-strength Loctite pre-applied to the included hardware. If hardware backs out, we recommend using Loctite Blue 242.

title: HTD Timing Belts (15mm)
body_html:
Description

HTD Belts are lighter, more efficient, and require lower maintenance than chains. 

Paired with the HTD Pulley, HTD Belts are designed to handle heavier loads and attain greater performance because of a deeper tooth profile. 

Features

  • Fiberglass tensile cords 
  • Labeled for easy size identification

If you need help determining which HTD belt size to use, we recommend ReCalc.
